backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor with products, orders, user profiles, and new service quote management including create, view, list, and update functions with admin authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected files, components, and test IDs for UX improvements, quote requests, admin lead management, and trust‑signal updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptive summaries for all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind and OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes and applies base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML root file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for storefront, cart, checkout, request‑quote, and admin sections with theme and toaster providers.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with contact info, quick links, social icons, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, navigation links, and cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main page layout with header, footer, and routed content area.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays product details in a card with image, description, price, and link to product page.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders an FAQ section using an accordion with predefined questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Shows customer testimonials in a grid of cards with ratings and review text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Displays trust badges highlighting certifications and service guarantees.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quotes via the actor with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Provides hooks to retrieve all orders and update order status through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Supplies CRUD and archive/restore hooks for products using the actor and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the current user's role from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for login, logout, and identity management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Defines a mutation hook to place orders and refresh order data.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Provides hooks to fetch active products and individual products from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Creates a mutation hook to submit service quote requests with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind and CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout that handles authentication, role validation, and renders navigation for admin sections.
Admin interface for viewing, sorting, updating, and annotating service quote leads.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Displays all orders with status controls and updates via admin actions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Admin CRUD interface for products, including creation, editing, and archiving logic.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart, allowing quantity changes, item removal, and navigation to checkout or products.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements checkout workflow with form validation, order submission, and redirect to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details, including order ID, with navigation back to storefront.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays a product's details with quantity selection and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Provides a form to request a service quote with validation and success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Renders the storefront hero, trust content, and active product listings with navigation to quotes or products.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with add, update, remove, clear, and total calculation features.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended OKLCH-based color tokens, custom animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s schema version, goals, architectural notes, and a list of existing features for the spray-foam storefront app.
